summary: Iteration 7 covers the nav reorg (Ventas/Compras groups with Articulos at top), new Presupuestos (sales-only) document type, and moving the Consumo IA widget from Facturas Recibidas into the central Admin panel. Backend pytest: 7/7 passed for /api/presupuestos CRUD + numeración desde series_venta['presupuestos'], /api/admin/consumos-ia shape+auth, licencias CRUD, purchase pedidos numeración. Frontend Playwright: sidebar groups (unlabeled top with Panel+Artículos, Ventas: Clientes/Presupuestos/Pedidos/Albaranes/Facturas, Compras: Proveedores/Pedidos/Albaranes/Facturas, Sistema: Ajustes) all render with expected data-testids. /ventas/presupuestos renders presupuestos-venta-page, dialog serie dropdown populated from live series_venta (['A 2026','T 2026','P 2026']), creating a presupuesto with lines saves, appears in the list, no Importar IA button on presupuestos venta. Ventas Pedidos uses venta series; Compras Pedidos/Albaranes use series_compra (['C']) and show importar-ia-button. Facturas Recibidas no longer shows the consumo-ia-resumen widget; manual+IA buttons still render. Ajustes shows 4 counter cols in Series de venta (PRÓX. PRESUP./PEDIDO/ALBARÁN/FACTURA) and 2 in Series de compra. Admin: /admin/login authenticates admin@nexopro.com/Admin1234!, /admin renders admin-panel-page, licences table + new 'Consumo de IA' section with 3 KPI cards (ia-total-lecturas=2, tokens=2723, 0,0039 €) and per-client rows (consumo-cliente-row-0). Licencias CRUD verified end-to-end (create → delete).

minor.issue: Accepts estado ONLY as multipart/form field (Form(...)) instead of JSON body. Frontend uses api.js which apparently sends form-data OK, but any generic JSON PATCH returns 422. Consider accepting JSON for API consistency.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Non-blocking a11y warning; add <DialogDescription/> or aria-describedby to silence.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription to Dialog components to remove Radix a11y warnings.
(Optional) Accept JSON body on PATCH /api/admin/licencias/{id}/estado in addition to Form for API consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _make_documento_routes now covers presupuestos with prefix PRE and uses series_venta.contadores.presupuestos correctly. Verified counter increments 3→4 after create.

GET /api/admin/consumos-ia aggregates by license_key and joins with licencias for empresa name; returns {num_lecturas,total_tokens,coste_total_eur,clientes[]}. Handles __sin_licencia__ bucket for consumos without license_key (shows 'Sin identificar'). Solid.
AdminPanel.jsx: uses getAdminConsumoIA + eurCoste; handles empty clientes list; per-client rows use license_key as key. Good.

Documentos.jsx uses props entidad+operacion (no tabs), single page per route — clean. permiteIA = esCompra && entidad!=='presupuestos' correctly hides IA for presupuestos even if hypothetically /compras/presupuestos existed.
Ajustes.jsx now silently drops empty-nombre series (sv/sc filter) before save — fixes prior UX foot-gun. Verified.
FacturasRecibidas.jsx: consumo-ia-resumen and its container fully removed; imports pruned. Nothing left behind.

seed_data_creation: Created + cleaned ephemeral presupuesto (TEST_Presu_Cliente/TEST_UI_Presu_Cliente), pedido de compra (TEST_Prov_Ped), licencia (TEST_LicX/TEST_UI_LicZ). Also cleaned a stale TEST_LicX from a previous half-failed run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live series in Ajustes are 'A 2026', 'T 2026', 'P 2026' (venta) and 'C' (compra). Presupuesto numeración follows serie 'contadores.presupuestos'; A 2026 next presup was 3 → became 4 after test. /api/admin/consumos-ia returns 2 lecturas / 2723 tokens / 0.0039 € aggregated under 'Sin identificar' (existing consumos_ia rows have no license_key — new POST /extraccion/pdf now stores licencia). Admin PATCH estado uses Form field, not JSON.
